s: Mahatma Gandhi National Rural Employment Guarantee Act was passed in :
x: The Indian Parliament passed the National Rural Employment Guarantee Act (NREGA) on 23 August, 2005. The Act was notified on 7 September, 2005 and came into force on 2 February, 2006 in 200 backward districts. On 2 October, 2009 an amendment was made in the National Rural Employment Guarantee Act 2005, to change the nomenclature of the Act from NREGA to Mahatma Gandhi National Rural Employment Guarantee Act (MGNREGA). MGNREGA was implemented in 200 districts in the first phase with effect from February, 2006 and extended subsequently, to additional 113 and 17 districts (total 330 districts) w.e.f. April 1, 2007 and May 15, 2007, respectively. The remaining districts were included under the Act w.e.f. April 1, 2008. The Viksit Bharat-Guarantee for Rozgar and Ajeevika Mission (Gramin) or VB-G RAM G Act, 2025 was enacted by the Parliament in December, 2025 to replace MGNREGA. The VB-G RAM G Act, 2025 represents a comprehensive statutory overhaul of MGNREGA, aligning rural employment with the long-term vision of Viksit Bharat 2047, while strengthening accountability, infrastructure outcomes and income security. The Act modernizes the rural wage scheme by increasing guaranteed employment to 125 days per household and linking work with durable rural infrastructure.

The purpose of the Himayat scheme launched by the Ministry of Rural Development is to
o: Spread secular ideas among the rural population
Form self help groups for rural women
Impart placement linked skill development to the youth from J&K

s:
Which of the following schemes were fully merged into the Sampoorna Grameen Rozgar Yojana?

A. Samagra Awaas Yojana

B. Jawahar Gram Samriddhi Yojana

C. Employment Assurance Scheme

D. Swarnajayanti Gram Swarozgar Yojana
x: SGRY (Sept 2001) replaced JGSY and EAS. SGSY was a separate self-employment scheme, so B and C only is correct.

s: Garib Kalyan Rojgar Abhiyaan (GKRA) was launched by the government of India in ______ to boost employment and livelihood opportunities for returnee migrant workers.
x: Garib Kalyan Rojgar Abhiyan was launched in 2020 as a campaign for returnee migrant workers.

s: The objective of Jawahar Rojgar Yojna is to :
o: Provide employment to youth in rural areas
Strengthen the rural economic and social structure
x: JRY (1989) aimed to generate employment for the rural unemployed and strengthen rural economic and social structure, so all the statements hold and 'All of the above' is right.

s:
Consider the following in respect of ‘National Career Service.’

I. National Career Services is an initiative of the Department of Personnel and Training, Government of India.

II. National Career Service has been launched in a Mission Mode to improve the employment opportunities to uneducated youth of the country.
Which of the above statements is/are correct?
x: National Career Service is a job-matching portal under the Labour & Employment ministry, not the Department of Personnel and Training, so statement I is wrong. Statement II is also wrong, since it is not meant only for uneducated youth.

s: Which Ministry is the nodal Ministry for MGNREGA?
o: Ministry of Skill Development and Entrepreneurship
x: MGNREGA is administered by the Ministry of Rural Development.

s: What is Recognition of Prior Learning under PMKVY intended to do?
o: Provide working capital to street vendors
Certify existing skills against the National Skills Qualifications Framework
Provide EPF support for new formal jobs
x: Recognition of Prior Learning certifies skills that individuals already possess against the National Skills Qualifications Framework (NSQF).

s: Which agency implements the Prime Minister's Employment Generation Programme (PMEGP)?
x: PMEGP is administered by the Ministry of MSME and implemented by the KVIC.

s: DDU-GKY, which provides placement-linked skilling to rural poor youth, has its roots in the special projects of which programme?
x: DDU-GKY (2014, Ministry of Rural Development) grew out of the special projects of SGSY, not PMEGP.

s: Under which Ministry is PM-SVANidhi, which gives collateral-free loans to street vendors?
x: PM-SVANidhi is run by the Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs, not MSME.

s: PM Vishwakarma supports how many traditional artisan trades?
x: PM Vishwakarma (MSME) covers 18 traditional artisan trades with training, toolkits and credit.

s: Which of the following pairs is correctly matched?
o: Garib Kalyan Rojgar Abhiyan – Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs
PM Vishwakarma – Ministry of Rural Development
National Career Service – Ministry of Labour and Employment
x: National Career Service (2015) is a Labour and Employment portal; DDU-GKY and Garib Kalyan Rojgar Abhiyan are Rural Development, PM Vishwakarma is MSME.

s: Under PMEGP, what is the maximum project cost now allowed for a manufacturing unit?
x: The PMEGP cap is ₹50 lakh for manufacturing and ₹20 lakh for service units (earlier ₹25 lakh / ₹10 lakh).

s: For whom was the Garib Kalyan Rojgar Abhiyan (2020), a 125-day campaign, meant?
x: It was a 125-day Rural Development campaign for returnee migrants in 116 districts of 6 States.

s: When was the PM-Viksit Bharat Rozgar Yojana, which gives incentives for formal jobs, launched?
x: The PM-Viksit Bharat Rozgar Yojana, a formal job incentive, was launched on 15 August 2025.

s: What is the range of margin money subsidy under PMEGP?
x: PMEGP gives margin money of 15-35% of the project cost for new non-farm micro-enterprises.

s: Under PMEGP, what is the maximum project cost now allowed for a service unit?
x: The PMEGP cap is ₹50 lakh for manufacturing and ₹20 lakh for service units (earlier ₹25 lakh and ₹10 lakh).

s: In which year was the Deen Dayal Upadhyaya Grameen Kaushalya Yojana (DDU-GKY) launched?
x: DDU-GKY was launched in 2014 by the Ministry of Rural Development for placement-linked skilling of rural poor youth.

s: In which year was the National Career Service portal of the Ministry of Labour and Employment launched?
x: The National Career Service, a job-matching portal, was launched in 2015 by the Ministry of Labour and Employment.

s: PMEGP met its target of setting up how many micro-enterprises?
x: PMEGP met its target of 4.02 lakh micro-enterprises, 80% of them rural and 40% run by women (May 2026).

s: The Garib Kalyan Rojgar Abhiyan (2020) covered how many districts?
x: GKRA was a 125-day campaign in 116 districts of 6 States for returnee migrant workers.

s: In June 2026, Andhra Pradesh pooled rural development funds to give how many days of work in distressed rural pockets?
x: AP pooled funds to provide 125 days of work in distressed rural pockets.

s: What was the average number of days of MGNREGA work per household in Andhra Pradesh in 2025-26?
x: In Andhra Pradesh the average days per household fell from 51.62 (2024-25) to 43.37 (2025-26).

s:
Consider the following statements about MGNREGA in Andhra Pradesh:
1. Person-days fell from 2,422.84 lakh in 2024-25 to 1,859.77 lakh in 2025-26.
2. Average days of work per household rose between 2024-25 and 2025-26.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
x: Person-days fell to 1,859.77 lakh, and average days per household also fell (51.62 to 43.37), so only 1 is correct.

1. Samagra Awas Yojana

Consider the following events and arrange them in correct chronological order starting from the earliest to the last activity :
1. Pradhan Mantri Gramodaya Yojana
2. Rural Employment Generation Programme
3. Prime Minister Rozgar Yojana
4. Valmiki Ambedkar Awas Yojana
Select the correct answer from the codes given below:
x: The given schemes and their launching years are as follows : Scheme/Programme Launch Year Pradhan Mantri Gramodaya Yojana 2000-01 Rural Employment Generation Programme 1995 Prime Minister Rozgar Yojana 1993 Valmiki Ambedkar Awas Yojana 2001 Hence, the correct chronological order is given in option (d).

s:
Arrange the following schemes launched by the Government of India in chronological order and choose the correct answer from the codes given below :
1. Integrated Rural Development Programme
2. Swarnjayanti Gram Swarozgar Yojana
3. National Rural Employment Guarantee Act
4. Pradhan Mantri Jan-Dhan Yojana
Codes :
x: The timeline of the launching of given schemes is as follows: Scheme Launching Year Integrated Rural Development Programme – 1980 (at all India level) Swarnjayanti Gram Swarozgar Yojana – 1999 National Rural Employment Guarantee – 2006 Act (MGNREGA) Pradhan Mantri Jan-Dhan Yojana – 2014 Hence, the correct chronological order is given in option (a).

src: APPSC Group-III Panchayat Secretary Screening Test 2017
s: Which one of the following works is not permissible under MGNREGA?
x:
the printed options did not include the correct answer (None of these (all are permissible)); it is added as option 5.
cattle shelters were added to MGNREGA permissible works in 2014 — now all four options are permissible (MGNREGA Schedule I; MGNREGA itself was replaced by the VB-G RAM G Act in 2025)
None of the four is barred: fish/farm ponds, mini percolation tanks and compost (NADEP/vermi-compost) pits are Schedule I works, and cattle shelters for eligible households were added in 2014, so 'cattle shed' (printed key) is wrong.

src: APPSC Group-III Panchayat Secretary Mains Paper-II Rural Dev
s: Under the DDU-GKY projects, how much percentage of contribution of State Government can be in kind?
o: Contribution in kind is not permitted
x: Kept on the printed key (10 percent): the DDU-GKY guideline clause on a state contribution in kind could not be traced in the 2016 policy guidelines. The 60:40 Centre–State cash share is the settled fact.

src: APPSC Group-I Preliminary Paper-I General Studies 2023
s:
Which of the following is not a feature of MGNREGS?

I. Guaranteed minimum wage employment

II. Rights-based employment scheme

III. Generation of wage employment in rural areas

IV. Provision of nutritious food
x: The stem is garbled: guaranteed wage employment, a rights-based scheme and rural wage employment are features of MGNREGS, while providing nutritious food is not – so the set of features is I, II and III.

src: APPSC Group-III Panchayat Secretary Mains Paper-II Rural Dev
s: Which section of NREGA Act, 2005 permits Social Audit?
x:
MGNREGA, 2005 was replaced by the Viksit Bharat – Guarantee for Rozgar and Ajeevika Mission (Gramin) Act, 2025 — now VB-G RAM G, in force from 1 July 2026 (Praveen CA360 Aug 2026, src/current-affairs/praveen-ca360-2026-08-magazine.txt; Rocket CA Feb 2026)
Section 17 of MGNREGA, 2005 requires the Gram Sabha to conduct regular social audits of all works in the Gram Panchayat (now replaced by the VB-G RAM G Act, 2025 from 1 July 2026).

src: APPSC Group-III Panchayat Secretary Mains Paper-II Rural Dev
s: MNREGA programme fund flow is monitored through?
x: In Andhra Pradesh, MGNREGA (APREGS) fund flow was tracked through the TCS-built RAGA software (RAGAsoft), down to mandals and gram panchayats.

src: APPSC Group-III Panchayat Secretary Mains Paper-II Rural Dev
s: A village social auditor for inspection of community works under MNREGA shall be?
o: A post master or any other Government Servant
x: MGNREGA social audits are done by the Gram Sabha with village social auditors who must not be political persons or interested parties, to keep the audit independent.
